# liveness

```go
import "github.com/Bugs5382/go-saga-orchestration/liveness"
```

Package liveness serves the WorkerLiveness gRPC service \(saga.v1\) that action workers use to report on the steps the engine dispatched to them.

The stream protocol lives in Server; what a report does lives behind the Reporter interface. StoreReporter is the default: it checks the run is waiting for the reported step, records the outcome in a store.Store, wakes the run on success, and compensates on failure. An application that embeds the engine and keeps its own bookkeeping \(a verb registry elsewhere, its own audit or gating\) can pass its own Reporter, usually wrapping StoreReporter.

## Variables

<a name="ErrRunNotFound"></a>

```go
var (
    // ErrRunNotFound is returned by a Reporter for a run it doesn't know. The
    // server answers it with codes.NotFound.
    ErrRunNotFound = errors.New("liveness: run not found")
    // ErrStepNotAwaited is returned by a Reporter when the run isn't waiting
    // for the reported step and attempt (a stale, duplicate or misrouted
    // report). The server answers it with codes.FailedPrecondition; a worker
    // should acknowledge the dispatch and drop it.
    ErrStepNotAwaited = errors.New("liveness: step not awaited")
)
```

<a name="AdvancePublisher"></a>
## type AdvancePublisher

AdvancePublisher wakes a run once a worker completes its step. The engine's Publisher satisfies it.

```go
type AdvancePublisher interface {
    PublishSagaAdvance(ctx context.Context, runID string) error
}
```

<a name="Compensator"></a>
## type Compensator

Compensator rolls back the completed steps of a run whose step failed. \*engine.Coordinator satisfies it.

```go
type Compensator interface {
    CompensateFailedStep(ctx context.Context, runID uuid.UUID, failedStepID string) error
}
```

<a name="Reporter"></a>
## type Reporter

Reporter takes workers' reports on the steps they were sent.

CheckStep runs when a worker starts a job, before it is acknowledged. CompleteStep and FailStep run on the terminal event; implementations should check again, since time passes between start and finish. Return an error wrapping ErrRunNotFound or ErrStepNotAwaited to refuse a report; any other error is answered with codes.Internal and its text is not sent to the worker.

```go
type Reporter interface {
    CheckStep(ctx context.Context, runID uuid.UUID, stepID string, attempt int) error
    CompleteStep(ctx context.Context, runID uuid.UUID, stepID string, attempt int, result map[string]any) error
    FailStep(ctx context.Context, runID uuid.UUID, stepID string, attempt int, code, message string, retryable bool) error
}
```

NewServer returns a Server that hands reports to r and logs to l. A nil l is silent unless a stream's context carries a logger \(sagalog.NewContext\).

<a name="Server.ExecuteStep"></a>
### func \(\*Server\) ExecuteStep

```go
func (s *Server) ExecuteStep(stream pb.WorkerLiveness_ExecuteStepServer) error
```

ExecuteStep is the bidirectional RPC workers use to report on a dispatched action. Frame protocol:

1. Worker sends StartJob\{run\_id, step\_id, attempt\}.
2. Server checks the run is waiting for that step and attempt, then replies Acknowledged\{\}; otherwise it ends the stream with NotFound or FailedPrecondition.
3. Worker streams Heartbeat\{\} messages while executing \(optional\).
4. Worker sends Complete\{result\_json\} \(success\) OR Error\{code, message, retryable\} \(failure\).
5. Server processes the terminal message and ends the stream.

Transport errors \(network drop, EOF before a terminal message\) leave the run waiting; redelivery of the dispatch and the worker's idempotency handle the retry.

<a name="StoreReporter"></a>
## type StoreReporter

StoreReporter is the default Reporter, backed by a store.Store.

A report is accepted only while the run is paused on the reported step with that attempt and an awaited action, as ActionVerb leaves it. CompleteStep merges the result into the run's variables and publishes an advance; FailStep fails the run and, when Compensator is set, compensates the steps that finished before it.

```go
type StoreReporter struct {
    Store store.Store
    // Advance wakes the run after a completion. nil leaves waking to the
    // timer, which finds the wakeup CompleteAction sets.
    Advance AdvancePublisher
    // Compensator rolls back a failed run. nil fails the run without
    // compensation.
    Compensator Compensator
    // Logger is optional; nil is silent unless the context carries a logger.
    Logger golog.Logger
}
```
